Fort Stanton Cave, an extensive limestone cave within the NCA is over 26 miles long making it the third longest cave in New Mexico, the 20th longest cave in the U.S., the 76th longest in the world, and the largest cave managed by the BLM. Modern-day cavers have been exploring its passages for over 50 years and continue their explorations and study as part of the Fort Stanton Cave Study Project (FSCSP). The FSCSP is a non-profit organization whose mission is to conduct and promote exploration, public education, scientific research, and environmentally sound management of the caves and karst within and surrounding the NCA. pages.text: New Orleans cruise ship collision: All passengers rescued in 'miracle on the Mississippi' Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision 3 days ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Ana Faguy Watch: Cruise ship seen sinking after collision with cargo ship in New Orleans Some 130 people on a cruise ship docked in New Orleans have been rescued after it was struck by a tanker. The cruise ship, American Heritage, was left lying on its side in the Mississippi River after it was hit by the cargo vessel Atlantic Asphalt. The collision left 32 people from the stricken riverboat in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for. Officials hailed it as a "miracle on the Mississippi". The exact cause of the crash remains under investigation, but US Coast Guard Capt Melanie Burnham said: "There seems to be some type of a loss of steering." New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno told a news conference on Friday that all credit in the rescue effort should go to first responders who "literally jumped right in to help". "We have zero people unaccounted for, which truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," Moreno said. Calls about the collision began around 13:30 EST (18:30 GMT) on Friday, when people began trying to help passengers escape the boat as it took on water, Port of New Orleans chief Melanie Montroll told the news conference. SCIENCE LAELAPS Newfound Fossil Octopus and Squid Were Giants By Riley Black Published March 10, 2015 • 4 min read A good fossil squid is hard to find. The invertebrates are too squishy to leave much behind, and only in truly exceptional circumstances do paleontologists get to see much more than the chitinous supports the cephalopods kept on the inside. Octopus are even more confounding. Without any remnants of an internal shell, the eight-armed quick-change artists are like prehistoric ghosts. But do not despair. The jaws of ancient coleoids give us reason for hope, and have just revealed a pair of prehistoric cephalopods that may have rivaled today’s ocean giants in size. Described by Kazushige Tanabe and colleagues in Acta Palaeontologica Polonica , the two lower jaws were found in roughly 80 million year old rock around Hokkaido, Japan’s Haboro-futamata Dam. Both were preserved in three-dimensional detail, providing Tanabe and coworkers with enough anatomical clues to figure out that they were left behind by previously-unknown species. Octopus and squid beaks can be very informative fossils. That’s because marine biologists have spent a great deal of time studying the chitinous beaks of modern cephalopods. Cách tốt nhất và nhanh nhất để bạn nhận tiền hoàn thuế là ký gửi theo phương thức điện tử miễn phí vào tài khoản tài chính của bạn. Chương trình của IRS được gọi là ký gửi trực tiếp. Nó đơn giản, an toàn và bảo mật. Đây cũng là hệ thống chuyển khoản điện tử được sử dụng để gửi gần 98% tất cả các phúc lợi An sinh Xã hội và Cựu Chiến binh vào hàng triệu tài khoản. Je publie sur Tisseur de Voies, le site où je calcule des boucles vélo avec retour en train, une carte qui répond à une question simple : depuis ma ville, jusqu’où puis-je partir à vélo en prenant un seul train ? On choisit une ville parmi 60 et une durée de train aller, de 0 à 4 heures. La carte montre en rose les véloroutes des boucles qu’on peut rejoindre, et en bleu les gares atteintes, plus foncées quand elles sont proches. Ici, Paris avec une heure de train : 1 763 boucles, contre 323 qui partent des gares parisiennes. pages.text: Nobel Peace Prize AR | الأمم المتحدة Skip to main content الأمم المتحدة وجائزة نوبل للسلام الأمم المتحدة وجائزة نوبل للسلام استلهم ألفريد نوبل وصيته التي حررها عام 1895 من إيمانه بوحدة الأسرة الإنسانية. ونصّت الوصية على أن تُمنح جائزة نوبل للسلام للشخص الذي يبذل أكبر جهد في سبيل «تعزيز الأخوّة بين الأمم، وإلغاء الجيوش الدائمة أو تقليصها، وعقد مؤتمرات السلام وتشجيعها». مُنحت جائزة نوبل للسلام المرموقة 13 مرة للأمم المتحدة و وكالاتها المتخصصة وصناديقها وبرامجها ، والمنظمات المرتبطة بها، ولمسؤولين حاليين وسابقين في المنظمة. وقد نالت المفوضية السامية للأمم المتحدة لشؤون اللاجئين هذه الجائزة مرتين، في عامي 1954 و 1981 . وكرّمت لجنة نوبل النرويجية أيضًا أمينين عامين للأمم المتحدة، هما كوفي عنان و داغ همرشولد ، تقديرًا لجهودهما. وعقب فوزه بالجائزة مناصفة مع الأمم المتحدة عام 2001، أعرب الأمين العام كوفي عنان، في كلمة وجهها إلى موظفي المنظمة، عن أمله في أن «تدفعنا هذه الجائزة إلى المضي قدمًا، وتشجعنا جميعًا على النهوض بمهامنا بعزيمة أشد». «على مدى مئة عام، سعت لجنة نوبل النرويجية إلى توطيد التعاون المنظّم بين الدول. وقد أتاحت نهاية الحرب الباردة للأمم المتحدة أخيرًا أن تنهض على نحو أكمل بالدور الذي أُنشئت من أجله. وتقف المنظمة اليوم في طليعة الجهود الرامية إلى تحقيق السلام والأمن في العالم، وفي صدارة التعبئة الدولية لمواجهة التحديات الاقتصادية والاجتماعية والبيئية التي تواجه العالم... وتود لجنة نوبل النرويجية، في عامها المئوي، أن تعلن أن الطريق الوحيد القائم على التفاوض لتحقيق السلام والتعاون على الصعيد العالمي يمر عبر الأمم المتحدة». معهد نوبل النرويجي أوسلو، 12 تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 2001 الحائزون على جائزة نوبل من الأمم المتحدة 2026 - نافانيثيم بيلاي مُنحت جائزة نوبل للسلام لعام 202

After arriving she was told she had exceeded her 90-day visa-free allowance to the Schengen area and was put on a return flight, but Pugh said this was a database error and that she had only spent 22 days in the area. The European Commission said it is the responsibility of individual countries to correct any errors. The 61-year-old said the experience made her feel "like a criminal", but so far she has been unable to identify the source of the error. Her experience also cost her hundreds of pounds after she had to pay for her return flight back to the UK and she lost money she had already spent on the holiday. The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library is set to open in July 2026 outside Medora, North Dakota. Photograph by Image Professionals GmbH, Alamy Stock Photo By Stephanie Pearson Published October 21, 2025 Theodore Roosevelt first traveled to the Badlands on a hunting trip in 1883. He was so taken by the otherworldly landscape of pastel buttes, trilling meadowlarks, and disappearing bison, that he returned in 1884 to grieve the simultaneous deaths of his wife and mother, raising cattle and working on the wild frontier for almost three years. Its “desolate, grim beauty” so changed Roosevelt that he famously wrote, “I would not have been president had it not been for my experience in North Dakota .” Opening on July 4, 2026, the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library celebrates the Badlands as much as it does the 26th president. Designed by Norwegian architectural firm Snøhetta, the state-of-the-art, sustainable library sits high on a lonely butte outside of Medora, a military camp turned frontier town named after a French nobleman’s wife. The 93,000-square-foot library disappears into its surroundings, camouflaged by a living roof sprouting native plants, part of a 1.3-mile walking trail that provides sweeping views toward the national park. The Redding-based district office oversees field offices in Alturas, Arcata, Redding and Susanville and a field station in Cedarville. The district contains two distinct regions. On the east, the Applegate and Eagle Lake field offices oversee vast expanses of public lands in a high desert landscape, including about a million and a half acres in far western Nevada. Small communities depend on public lands for economic benefits, primarily through livestock grazing, and tourism uses ranging from hunting to mountain biking. These lands provide habitat for 14 wild horse herds and special status species, such as greater sage grouse. On the west, the Arcata and Redding field offices manage smaller, scattered blocks of public land with more emphasis on recreation demands from urban areas. The district includes the upper Colorado River corridor along with the White and Yampa rivers. It is home to some of the largest deer and elk herds in the area, along with pronghorn, bighorn sheep and a wide variety of other wildlife. The Northwest District contains the majority of the Colorado range of the Greater Sage Grouse. The Northwest District also manages 7.1 million acres of subsurface minerals, which includes some of the most productive oil and natural gas fields in the state, four of Colorado’s nine coal mines and vast deposits of oil shale. Rowers glide across the Hardangerfjord, Norway’s second longest fjord and the world’s fifth longest, in the rugged county of Vestland. Thomas Ekström By Kerry Walker Published October 20, 2026 With its deep fjords and high mountains, Vestland, a county in southwestern Norway created in 2020 through the merging of two other counties, looks like something out of a Tolkien novel. The region is a global leader in sustainable outdoor adventure, with noiseless, zero-emission catamarans that glide through the fantasy landscapes. In Bergen, the charming coastal capital, the Hanseatic Museum , which tells the story of the medieval Northern European merchant class, will reopen after a renovation, while the restaurant Gaptrast , which earned a second Michelin star in 2026, continues bringing the Nordic wilds to diners’ plates. The city will also be getting its own state-of-the-art boat in 2027 for nearby fjord cruises. Farther afield, visitors can venture on thrilling treks in national parks like Jostedalsbreen , capped by Europe’s biggest glacier , and Folgefonna .
